hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The score is permanently determined by the sum of the first two elements: nums[0] + nums[1].

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Continuously remove pairs of elements from the front as long as their sum equals this target score.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Return the total count of valid consecutive pair operations.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass pair scan until first non-matching sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full recursive search is unnecessary since pair choice is strictly sequential.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the target score is fixed by the very first pair.
